_about: The vocabulary this pack delivers, on professional-services: pre-sales, contracts and scope, pricing and margin, staffing, risks and commitments, and billing. Derived from the questions in questions.json.
name: client-engagements

Pursuit.definition: An opportunity to win work from a client, from first conversation to a signed statement of work, a loss or a withdrawal.
Pursuit.scope_note: Ends when it is won, lost or withdrawn; the work that follows a win is an Engagement.

StatementOfWork.definition: The signed contract document that sets an engagement's scope, price, staffing and terms.
StatementOfWork.label: statement of work

ChangeOrder.definition: A dated amendment to a statement of work that changes its scope, price or terms, with the reason for it.
ChangeOrder.label: change order

ScopeItem.definition: One in-scope or out-of-scope statement in a statement of work or change order, with the clause it sits in.
ScopeItem.label: scope item

SolutionDocument.definition: A solution design, proposal or approach document we wrote for a pursuit or an engagement.
SolutionDocument.label: solution document

Assumption.definition: Something a solution, price or statement of work takes as true about the client's environment, confirmed or not.

PricingModel.definition: How an engagement, pursuit or change order is priced: the commercial model, the price, the cost and the margin it was priced at.
PricingModel.label: pricing model

MarginBand.definition: The approved floor and target margin for a commercial model, as set by the firm's pricing policy at a point in time.
MarginBand.label: margin band

Assignment.definition: A person or an open position in a role on an engagement or pursuit, from a date to a date, planned or actual, with its rates.
Assignment.scope_note: A planned assignment may name only a role; an actual one names the person.

Platform.definition: A technology product or platform an engagement or solution works on: a core banking system, a cloud, a data platform.

Regulation.definition: A named regulatory instrument or guideline an engagement must respect, cited by its official title.
Regulation.scope_note: Only real, cited instruments (e.g. an OSFI guideline); never an invented category.

Risk.definition: An open risk or blocker to an engagement, with an owner, a state and what it is waiting on.

Commitment.definition: Something one party promised another on a pursuit or engagement: what we promised in pre-sales, or what the client committed to provide.
Commitment.scope_note: Who made it is the promised_by relation; direction is not a separate class.

BillingMilestone.definition: A billable point in an engagement, usually tied to a deliverable's acceptance, with its amount.
BillingMilestone.label: billing milestone

Invoice.definition: An invoice issued to a client for a milestone or a period of time-and-materials work.

client_of.definition: The client an engagement or pursuit is for.

became.definition: The engagement a won pursuit turned into.

solution_for.definition: The pursuit or engagement a solution document was written for.
solution_for.label: solution for

involves_platform.definition: A platform the work or solution is built on or changes.
involves_platform.label: involves platform

subject_to.definition: A regulation the work must respect.
subject_to.label: subject to

assumes.definition: An assumption the solution, price or contract rests on.

confirmed_by.definition: Who or what confirmed an assumption.
confirmed_by.label: confirmed by

amends.definition: The statement of work a change order amends.

defines_scope.definition: A scope item the contract or change order brings in, in or out of scope.
defines_scope.label: defines scope

removes_scope.definition: A scope item a change order takes out of the contract.
removes_scope.label: removes scope

priced_by.definition: The pricing model that prices the work.
priced_by.label: priced by

held_to.definition: The margin band a price was judged against when it was set.
held_to.label: held to

staffs.definition: The engagement or pursuit an assignment is on.

assignee.definition: The person in an assignment; absent for an open planned position.

worked_on.definition: A person was actually assigned to an engagement. Derived from actual assignments.
worked_on.label: worked on

key_person_for.definition: A commitment depends on this named individual.
key_person_for.label: key person for

signs_off.definition: Who accepts a deliverable on the client's behalf.
signs_off.label: signs off

threatens.definition: What a risk would hurt if it happened.

waits_on.definition: Who a blocker or overdue commitment is waiting on.
waits_on.label: waits on

promised_by.definition: The party that made a commitment.
promised_by.label: promised by

commitment_for.definition: The pursuit or engagement a commitment was made in.
commitment_for.label: commitment for

required_by.definition: The regulation that obliges this piece of work.
required_by.label: required by

sponsors.definition: An executive sponsor or decision-maker for the work.

milestone_of.definition: The engagement or contract a billing milestone belongs to.
milestone_of.label: milestone of

bills_on.definition: The deliverable whose acceptance makes a milestone billable.
bills_on.label: bills on

invoices.definition: What an invoice bills: a milestone, or an engagement for time-and-materials work.

outcome_reason.label: outcome reason
outcome_reason.definition: Why it was won, lost or withdrawn, including what the client pushed back on.

estimated_value_cad.label: estimated value (CAD)
estimated_value_cad.definition: The expected contract value in Canadian dollars.

value_change_cad.label: value change (CAD)
value_change_cad.definition: How much the contract value moves, negative for a reduction.

in_scope.label: in scope
in_scope.definition: True when included, false when explicitly excluded.

clause.definition: The clause reference in the document that states it.

reusable.definition: Whether it can be shared as a starting point for other clients once anonymized.

state.definition: Whether the assumption has been checked.

priced_margin_pct.label: priced margin (%)
priced_margin_pct.definition: The margin the price was set at.

applies_to.label: applies to
applies_to.definition: The commercial model the band governs.

floor_pct.label: floor (%)
floor_pct.definition: The lowest margin approved without an exception.

target_pct.label: target (%)
target_pct.definition: The margin a price should aim for.

kind.definition: Whether this is the plan or what happened.

end_on.label: end
end_on.definition: Last day on the work; absent while open-ended.

allocation_pct.label: allocation (%)
allocation_pct.definition: Share of a full week on this work.

bill_rate_cad.label: bill rate (CAD/day)
bill_rate_cad.definition: Daily rate charged to the client.

cost_rate_cad.label: cost rate (CAD/day)
cost_rate_cad.definition: Daily cost of the person or position.

issuer.definition: The regulator or body that issued it, e.g. OSFI.

citation.definition: The official title and version or date.

kind.definition: A blocker is stopping work now; a risk might.

state.definition: Where the deliverable is in acceptance.

estimate_cad.label: estimate (CAD)
estimate_cad.definition: The cost it was priced at.

forecast_cad.label: forecast (CAD)
forecast_cad.definition: The current forecast cost to complete.

amount_cad.label: amount (CAD)
amount_cad.definition: What is billed when it is reached.

due_on.label: due
due_on.definition: When it is expected to be billable.
